eoe.text: Haliya, squire to Syr Vondam, stands with him on the Dawnsire's bridge when Captain Slats phorocasts that Vondam will die in the battle, and Vondam tells her to "Look to the Sum, Squire" before he goes to face the attack.

He turns out to be alive, with a pinhead hole through his head, and when he reasons that an anathema object on Sothera threatens the mission, Haliya reads out protocol seven, which requires destroying everything the object touches.
When Vondam asks whether she could order the destruction of all Taro-duend, Haliya refuses to kill a settlement of innocents, and she persuades him to let her go down to find Alpharael herself.

Haliya urges Vondam to order her death as protocol seven requires, but he refuses to destroy the ship, and afterward she judges that Vondam obeyed the Sum but that the massacre was still wrong, and that she can never be a Sunstar knight.
